definition: Everyday practices involving food, hospitality, clothing, leisure, celebrations, routines, consumption and shared physical spaces.
short_justification: Cultural correctness is frequently expressed through ordinary practices that are not reducible to abstract values or language.
source_frameworks: BLEnD; CulturalBench; Destatis time-use and household data
minimum_source_families: One cultural NLP benchmark; one German official or insider-practice source

definition: Culturally situated meaning expressed through register, forms of address, idioms, implicature, humour, dialect and conversational style.
short_justification: A response may be grammatically correct but culturally wrong because its register or implied meaning is inappropriate.
source_frameworks: Cultural linguistics; CultureLLM; BLEnD; German IDS/DWDS corpora
minimum_source_families: One linguistic or corpus source; one cultural NLP source

definition: Context-dependent expectations governing greetings, invitations, punctuality, boundaries, disagreement and public interpersonal conduct.
short_justification: Social acceptability in a concrete German situation cannot be fully represented by linguistic correctness or abstract value surveys.
minimum_source_families: One social-norm framework or benchmark; one German insider or empirical source

definition: Population attitudes and moral priorities concerning autonomy, authority, solidarity, justice, security, environment and contested social questions.
short_justification: Values are plural and distributional; they require survey-grounded representation rather than a single alleged national opinion.
minimum_source_families: One representative survey source; one pluralistic-alignment or cultural-evaluation paper

definition: Binding rights, obligations, administrative procedures, public policy and formal institutional constraints in Germany.
short_justification: What German law requires is distinct from what people prefer or informally expect.
source_frameworks: SafeWorld; Diverse Human Value Alignment; German federal and state authorities
minimum_source_families: One current official legal or institutional source; one alignment or geo-diverse safety source

definition: Religious practice, sacred meaning, ritual observance, religious diversity and context-dependent prohibitions.
short_justification: Ritual competence and sacred meaning cannot be reconstructed from generic values or everyday-practice categories alone.
source_frameworks: EVS/WVS religion modules; Inglehart-Welzel; religious-studies and community sources
minimum_source_families: One survey or scholarly source; one relevant community or authoritative practice source

definition: Household structures, partnership, caregiving, gender relations, childhood, ageing and intergenerational expectations.
short_justification: Family and generational structures have distinct demographic evidence and role-specific norms that disappear inside a generic values domain.
source_frameworks: EVS; WVS; BLEnD; Destatis family statistics
minimum_source_families: One representative survey or official statistical source; one cultural benchmark or social-science source

definition: Workplace culture, educational life, professional roles, associations, elections, volunteering and participation in public institutions.
short_justification: Role-specific practices in employment, education and civic life are neither merely general etiquette nor only binding law.
source_frameworks: EVS work and politics; WVS political participation; BLEnD; German labour education and election institutions
minimum_source_families: One work education or civic survey source; one German institutional source

domain_name: Cultural heritage history arts and collective memory
definition: Historical interpretation, commemoration, heritage, arts, public symbols, media references and collective memory.
short_justification: Without this domain the benchmark cannot measure historical sensitivity, commemoration or culturally meaningful symbolic references.
source_frameworks: CulturalBench; UNESCO heritage frameworks; German bpb archives museums and cultural institutions
minimum_source_families: One heritage or cultural-knowledge framework; one German archive museum or public-history source

definition: National, regional, ethnic, migration, disability, sexual and other identities, belonging and intergroup treatment in Germany.
short_justification: Identity and minority experience require explicit coverage and cannot be reduced to a generic safety label; stereotyping is assessed as a failure across this and other domains.
source_frameworks: EVS national identity; WVS migration; GlobalOpinionQA; pluralistic alignment; FADA and DeZIM
minimum_source_families: One population or identity survey source; one affected-community anti-discrimination or pluralistic-alignment source
